### Accessibility and behavior

- A labelled native button inside a scoped column header exposes aria-sort
- Tab reaches the button; Enter and Space cycle the state

Role: `button`.

Accessible name: `aria-label` strategy targeting `button`.

| Keyboard input | Declared outcome |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Focus the sort control |
| `Enter` | Cycle sort state |
| ` ` | Cycle sort state |

### Compatibility

The component owns its indicator state and emits {field,direction,active}; the consumer owns record sorting. Tri-state cycle is none/ascending/descending/none; binary mode cycles ascending/descending. Authored state prop changes resynchronise the indicator.
